units.source_text: 我在劝说K的时候，总是想给他讲清楚这一点。

en.t: When I tried to persuade K, I always wanted to make this point clear to him.

units.source_text: 可是只要我一开口，必遭到他的反驳，而且还搬出古人的事例加以佐证。

en.t: But as soon as I opened my mouth, he was sure to argue back, and he would cite examples from olden times to support himself.

units.source_text: 于是，我又不得不明确地指出那些古人与K的不同之处。

en.t: So I had to point out plainly how those people of old differed from K.

units.source_text: K若是能虚心接受的人也就罢了，

en.t: If K had been the sort of person who would accept that humbly, it would have been fine,

units.source_text: 可是以他的脾气，一旦争论到了这个地步，是绝不肯退让的，

en.t: but given his temperament, once an argument reached that point, he would never give ground,

units.source_text: 甚至还会更进一步，将嘴上说的付诸行动。

en.t: and he would even go a step further, putting into action what he had said.

units.source_text: 他就是这样一个可怕的人，也是一个了不起的人。

en.t: He was that sort of frightening man, and also an extraordinary one.

units.source_text: 他一边毁灭自己一边前进。

en.t: He moved forward while destroying himself.

units.source_text: 从结果来看，他只不过是在成功地毁掉自己这一点上很了不起罢了。

en.t: Judged by the result, he was extraordinary only in how successfully he destroyed himself.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，他也绝不是平凡的人。

en.t: Even so, he was certainly no ordinary person.

units.source_text: 熟知他个性的我，最终也只有缄口不言了。

en.t: Knowing his character so well, I finally had no choice but to keep silent.

units.source_text: 而且，在我看来，正如前面说过的，他好像是患了神经衰弱症。

en.t: Moreover, as I saw it, as I have said before, he seemed to be suffering from nervous exhaustion.

units.source_text: 即便我说服了他，他也必定会跟我争执一番。

en.t: Even if I persuaded him, he would certainly argue with me over it.
Although I was not afraid of quarreling with him,

units.source_text: 但一想起自己那不堪忍受的孤独处境，

en.t: when I thought back on my own unbearable loneliness,

units.source_text: 便不能忍受将我的朋友也置于同样的孤独境遇之中了。

en.t: I could not bear to place my friend in the same lonely situation.

units.source_text: 把他推入愈加孤独的境地，更是我不愿做的事。

en.t: Pushing him into an even lonelier state was something I wanted even less to do.

units.source_text: 因此，在他搬来后的一段时间里，我暂时没有说过他什么，

en.t: Therefore, for a while after he moved in, I said nothing about him,

units.source_text: 只是平和地观察着环境给他带来的影响。

en.t: and merely watched calmly to see what influence his surroundings would have on him.
